boundaries: All 225 server/cache records are candidates, not an installed ECU count.
Record position is its /ecus/index in factory input; cacheEcuInfoIndex points to /ecuInfo/index in cache input.
Every CAN/DoIP tuple retains transport semantics; DoIP target/client never becomes CAN request/reply.
Distinct DID namespace is not a distinct CAN address, physical ECU or independently readable DTC memory.
No new vehicle/API request or product allowlist change occurred.
7F22 is a stock failure marker, not nonzero software proof.
Exact-family Xtool row IDs are only family-level matches: they do not associate numbered INS/FRL/CDC subidentities, source names, suppliers, buses or DID namespaces.
Exact-family Xtool rows retain supplier alternatives; no supplier is selected by a shared code.
A valid cached code is historical metadata, not a newly observed reply; stock code can conditionally replace identity from repair metadata.
